title: Tax Filings
description: Prepare government tax returns from the ledger and preserve what was filed.

activity.emptyDescription: Post a sales invoice or credit memo while a tax provider is configured, and each commit appears here with its status.
activity.title: Provider commit for {document}
activity.summaryFailed: {provider} could not commit {document}. Check the reason below, then retry.
activity.summaryVoided: {document} was voided with {provider} after the document was voided.
activity.summarySkipped: {document} needs no provider commit, and none was sent.
activity.retryConfirmDescription: Send {document} to {provider} again. The commit replays under the same document code, so the provider cannot book it twice.
activity.retryStarted: Retry queued — the next scan commits it.
activity.retryFailed: The retry did not start. Try again.
activity.mismatchNotice: {provider} recorded {providerTax} but OpenBooks posted {merchantTax} of merchant tax. The provider figure is kept for review and never adjusted automatically.

empty: Choose a return and a period, then compute.

noForms.title: No tax returns configured
noForms.description: Import a jurisdiction pack or create a return in Setup → Taxes.

submission.title: How to file this return
submission.description: Use the configured filing channel and action below after reviewing the return.
submission.exportNotice: Working-copy exports are for review and records. They are not government submission files unless the configured filing method explicitly says otherwise.
submission.gst34Notice: GST34 is normally entered in CRA Account or NETFILE. CRA's uploadable .tax file can only be produced by CRA-certified software; PDF, CSV, and Excel are not accepted filing formats.

history.title: Previous filings
history.description: Versioned, immutable snapshots of prepared and submitted returns.
history.empty: No saved filings match these filters.
history.markFiledHint: Only mark this snapshot filed after the government accepts it. This action cannot be undone.

errors.periodNotClosed: The period must be closed before this filing can be marked filed. Close the period, then try again.
errors.alreadyFiled: This filing is already marked filed.
errors.stale: This filing changed since it was prepared. Refresh and prepare it again before marking filed.

provisions.title: Income Tax Provision
provisions.description: ASC 740 / IAS 12 — current and deferred tax, valuation allowance, and the rate reconciliation.
provisions.empty: No provision runs yet. Compute the first fiscal-year provision to get started.
provisions.emptyNoGrant: No provision runs yet. Only preparers with organization-wide report creation access can compute the first provision.

compute.title: Compute fiscal-year provision
compute.rowDescriptionRequiredPermanent: Permanent differences row {row} needs a description — add one or clear the amount.
compute.rowDescriptionRequiredTemporary: Temporary differences row {row} needs a description — add one or clear the row.
compute.computeFailed: The provision could not be computed.
compute.rowAmountRequiredPermanent: Permanent differences row {row} needs an amount — add one or clear the description.
compute.rowDifferenceRequiredTemporary: Temporary differences row {row} needs a difference — add one or clear the description.
compute.rowObjectRequiredPermanent: Permanent differences row {row} must be a grid row with a description and an amount — fix the line and try again.
compute.rowObjectRequiredTemporary: Temporary differences row {row} must be a grid row with a description, a category and a difference — fix the line and try again.

provisions.postFailed: The provision could not be posted.

oss.title: One-Stop-Shop returns
oss.description: Quarterly Union and monthly Import OSS returns from posted cross-border supplies, grouped by member state of consumption and rate.
oss.prepareFailed: The return could not be prepared.
oss.emptyDescription: Pick the scheme and period, then prepare the return. Register the OSS identification in Tax setup first — the return refuses without it.
oss.noLinesDescription: Nothing posted with a customer-country verdict falls in this period.

exportNotes.generic: Generic EU OSS layout for portal hand-keying.
exportNotes.DE: German portal layout: same filed figures grouped for the BOP upload. Confirm the portal template before uploading.
exportNotes.FR: French portal layout: same filed figures grouped for the portal upload. Confirm the portal template before uploading.
exportNotes.NL: Dutch portal layout: same filed figures grouped for the portal upload. Confirm the portal template before uploading.
exportNotes.IE: Irish ROS XML: same filed figures in the Revenue upload layout. Confirm the ROS template before uploading.

conflicts.badge: {count, plural, one {# document needs attention} other {# documents need attention}}
conflicts.title: Evidence conflicts to fix before posting
conflicts.description: These unposted documents claim cross-border treatment but their location signals name more than one country. Posting stays refused until the evidence agrees — fix each document where it lives.

advanced.title: Filing evidence and threshold
advanced.summary: ECB translation evidence and the distance-sales threshold

fx.title: ECB translation evidence
fx.pending: No evidence stored for this period yet — it is stored when you export the return, then the filed euro figures stay reproducible.

threshold.title: Distance-sales threshold (EUR 10,000)
threshold.status: €{total} of €{threshold} posted B2C turnover in {year}, VAT excluded.
threshold.uncovered: No ECB rate for {currencies} — the total excludes them. Add the rates before relying on this figure.
